title: The Great War
subtitle: World War I Campaigns
description: Follow the pivotal battles and events that shaped World War I across Europe and beyond.

chapters.title: The War Begins
chapters.intro: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand sparked a chain reaction that plunged Europe into unprecedented conflict.

events.title: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
events.narrative: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary was assassinated in this Balkan capital, triggering the July Crisis.
events.revealText: Sarajevo's pivotal moment led to Austria-Hungary's ultimatum to Serbia and the collapse of the European alliance system.

events.title: Austria-Hungary Declares War
events.narrative: Austria-Hungary officially declared war on Serbia from this imperial capital, setting off a chain of mobilizations.
events.revealText: Vienna's ultimatum and declaration were the formal beginning of the Great War that would consume Europe.

events.title: Germany Invades Belgium
events.narrative: German forces swept through this neutral country following the Schlieffen Plan to attack France.
events.revealText: Belgium's invasion triggered British entry into the war and brought the conflict west of the Rhine.

chapters.title: Trench Warfare
chapters.intro: The war became a grinding stalemate of trenches, artillery, and horrific casualties across the Western Front.

events.title: Battle of the Somme
events.narrative: This northern French region witnessed one of the deadliest battles in human history, with over 1 million casualties.
events.revealText: The Somme offensive exemplified the futility of trench warfare and the devastating cost of industrial combat.

events.title: Verdun Fortress
events.narrative: The French defended this heavily fortified region in a ten-month struggle against the German offensive.
events.revealText: Verdun became a symbol of French resistance and determination despite enormous loss of life on both sides.

events.title: Battle of Passchendaele
events.narrative: Canadian and British forces fought through mud and artillery in Belgium to capture this village.
events.revealText: Passchendaele's capture cost 325,000 casualties—demonstrating the Eastern Front's brutal attritional warfare.

title: World War II
subtitle: Axis vs. Allies
description: Experience the defining battles and turning points of humanity's deadliest conflict.

chapters.title: Nazi Expansion
chapters.intro: Hitler's Germany began a campaign of aggressive expansion across Europe, overrunning nation after nation.

events.title: Invasion of Poland
events.narrative: German forces blitzkrieg through Poland from the west while Soviet forces invade from the east.
events.revealText: Warsaw's fall marked the start of WWII and demonstrated the destructive power of mechanized warfare.

events.title: Fall of France
events.narrative: German forces defeated the French army and occupied this nation in a stunning six-week campaign.
events.revealText: Paris's fall shocked the world and showed the Wehrmacht's superior tactics and mobile warfare strategy.

events.title: Battle of Britain
events.narrative: RAF pilots defended this island nation against the Luftwaffe's aerial assault in the first major battle fought entirely by air forces.
events.revealText: London survived the Blitz, and German invasion plans were abandoned, proving Britain could stand alone.

chapters.title: The Eastern Front
chapters.intro: Germany invaded the Soviet Union in the largest military operation in history, resulting in titanic battles.

events.title: Operation Barbarossa
events.narrative: Three million German troops invaded the Soviet Union, advancing deep into Russia from this border city.
events.revealText: Minsk fell quickly but the campaign would bog down, consuming millions of soldiers in brutal fighting.

events.title: Siege of Leningrad
events.narrative: German forces encircled this great city for 900 days, starving civilians while the Red Army held the line.
events.revealText: Over 1 million perished but Leningrad never fell, becoming a symbol of Soviet defiance and resilience.

events.title: Battle of Stalingrad
events.narrative: Soviet and German forces fought house-to-house in this industrial city in the war's bloodiest battle.
events.revealText: Soviet victory at Stalingrad turned the tide on the Eastern Front and marked the beginning of Germany's defeat.

chapters.title: Pacific War
chapters.intro: Japan's expansion in Asia and the Pacific brought the United States into global conflict.

events.title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
events.narrative: Japan launched a surprise naval assault on the U.S. naval base, bringing America into World War II.
events.revealText: Pearl Harbor's destruction galvanized American resolve and turned the tide of the war in the Pacific.

events.title: Battle of Midway
events.narrative: The U.S. Navy sank four Japanese aircraft carriers in this crucial naval engagement in the Pacific.
events.revealText: Midway's victory reversed Japanese momentum and gave America the initiative in the Pacific War.

events.title: Atomic Bombing
events.narrative: The U.S. dropped atomic bombs on these cities, ending the Pacific War but introducing nuclear devastation to warfare.
events.revealText: Hiroshima and Nagasaki's destruction killed over 200,000 people and ushered in the nuclear age.

title: The Hunnic Invasions
subtitle: Attila's Path of Conquest
description: Follow Attila the Hun's relentless advance across Europe and the clash with the Roman Empire.

chapters.title: Rise of a Warlord
chapters.intro: From the steppes of Central Asia, Attila unified the Hunnic tribes and turned them into a war machine.

events.title: Hunnic Empire Unified
events.narrative: Attila inherited rulership of the Huns from this location on the steppes and began unifying the tribes.
events.revealText: The heart of Hunnic power lay in the Central Asian steppes where mounted archers trained and bred warhorses.

events.title: First Invasion of the Eastern Roman Empire
events.narrative: Hunnic forces crossed the Danube and invaded Byzantine territory, demanding tribute and ransom from this city.
events.revealText: Constantinople paid ransom to the Huns, establishing a pattern of extortion that would plague the empire.

chapters.title: Western Invasion
chapters.intro: Attila turned westward, bringing fire and devastation to the Roman provinces of Gaul and beyond.

events.title: Invasion of Gaul
events.narrative: Hunnic armies swept through the Roman province of Gaul, sacking cities and terrifying the population.
events.revealText: Paris itself was threatened, but Attila bypassed it to continue his rampage through the countryside.

events.title: Battle of the Catalaunian Plains
events.narrative: Roman and Visigothic forces united to face Attila in this crucial battle that checked his westward advance.
events.revealText: Though not a decisive victory, the Catalaunian Plains slowed Hunnic momentum and forced strategic retreat.

events.title: Invasion of Italy
events.narrative: Attila turned south and invaded the Italian peninsula, sacking cities and threatening the heart of the Western Empire.
events.revealText: Milan fell to the Huns, demonstrating that even the empire's heartland was vulnerable to Hunnic invasion.

chapters.title: The Decline
chapters.intro: Attila's sudden death and the succession disputes that followed marked the end of Hunnic dominance.

events.title: Death of Attila
events.narrative: Attila died on his wedding night at this location, possibly from a nosebleed or an assassin's blade.
events.revealText: The great warlord's death threw the Hunnic empire into chaos, and the empire rapidly fragmented.

events.title: Collapse of Hunnic Power
events.narrative: Without Attila's leadership, the Hunnic confederation splintered as tribes pursued their own interests.
events.revealText: The sons of Attila fought for control, and Germanic tribes rebelled, ending the age of Hunnic dominance.

title: The Roman Empire
subtitle: Rise and Expansion
description: Trace the legendary military campaigns that built the greatest empire of the ancient world.

chapters.title: The Republic Ascendant
chapters.intro: Rome's legions conquered the Mediterranean basin, establishing the foundation of future imperial greatness.

events.title: Battle of Cannae
events.narrative: Hannibal's Carthaginian forces defeated a larger Roman army in southern Italy through brilliant double envelopment.
events.revealText: Despite the massive Roman defeat, Rome's resilience and resources eventually wore down Carthage.

events.title: Conquest of Egypt
events.narrative: Octavian defeated Mark Antony and Cleopatra, bringing this ancient kingdom under Roman control.
events.revealText: Egypt's wealth and grain supply made Rome the undisputed master of the Mediterranean world.

chapters.title: Imperial Expansion
chapters.intro: The emperors pushed Rome's borders to their greatest extent, from Britain to Mesopotamia.

events.title: Conquest of Britain
events.narrative: Emperor Claudius ordered the invasion of Britain, beginning a century-long conquest of the island.
events.revealText: Roman legions brought civilization to Britain, establishing cities, roads, and military forts.

events.title: Trajan's Dacia Campaign
events.narrative: Emperor Trajan conquered the rich kingdom of Dacia, bringing Roman power to its maximum territorial extent.
events.revealText: Dacia's conquest added vast territories and mineral wealth to the empire, extending Rome to the Black Sea.

events.title: Parthian Wars
events.narrative: Trajan invaded Mesopotamia and reached the Persian Gulf, Rome's greatest extension eastward.
events.revealText: Though Trajan took Ctesiphon, Rome could not hold such distant territory and soon withdrew.

title: Character Home Quest
subtitle: Homes of Beloved Kids' Characters
description: Travel the globe to visit real-world places linked to famous children's characters and stories.

chapters.title: Neighborhood Adventures
chapters.intro: Start in cities and storybook towns connected to familiar characters from TV and children's books.

events.title: Bluey's Brisbane Backyard
events.narrative: This Australian city inspired the Heeler family's world in Bluey.
events.revealText: Bluey is set in Brisbane, with local parks, rivers, and neighborhoods shaping many episodes.

events.title: Peppa's London Day Trip
events.narrative: Peppa Pig adventures often reference this major UK city and its landmarks.
events.revealText: London appears in many Peppa stories, including visits to famous city attractions.

events.title: Paddington's Station Arrival
events.narrative: A young bear from Peru begins his UK journey at this famous London station.
events.revealText: Paddington Bear's iconic arrival gave the station his name in children's literature.

events.title: Peter Rabbit's Lake District
events.narrative: Beatrix Potter's countryside tales were inspired by this scenic region in northwest England.
events.revealText: The Lake District's farms and hills helped shape the world of Peter Rabbit.

events.title: Winnie-the-Pooh's Hundred Acre Wood
events.narrative: This forest in southern England inspired A. A. Milne's beloved Pooh stories.
events.revealText: Ashdown Forest is the real-world landscape behind the Hundred Acre Wood.

chapters.title: Storybook World Tour
chapters.intro: Continue across Europe and beyond to places tied to classic children's tales.

events.title: Heidi's Alpine Village
events.narrative: Heidi's mountain world is associated with this Swiss village near the Alps.
events.revealText: Maienfeld's alpine setting is widely linked to the timeless Heidi story.

events.title: Pippi Longstocking's Island Town
events.narrative: Swedish adaptations of Pippi Longstocking were famously filmed around this Baltic town.
events.revealText: Visby on Gotland became a recognizable backdrop for Pippi's adventures.

events.title: Moomin Seaside Inspiration
events.narrative: The cozy Moomin world draws from Nordic islands and coastal life near this Finnish town.
events.revealText: Naantali celebrates Moomin stories and reflects their gentle maritime atmosphere.

events.title: Pinocchio's Tuscany
events.narrative: Carlo Collodi's Pinocchio tale is rooted in this region of central Italy.
events.revealText: Florence and the surrounding Tuscan landscapes shaped the world of Pinocchio.

events.title: The Jungle Book's Indian Setting
events.narrative: Kipling's jungle stories are associated with forests of central India near this city.
events.revealText: The Jungle Book is strongly linked to central Indian wildlife landscapes around Madhya Pradesh.

title: Disney Location Journey
subtitle: Movie-Inspired Places Around the World
description: Explore real-world locations that inspired settings in Disney and Pixar favorites.

chapters.title: Oceans and Wild Lands
chapters.intro: Begin with reefs, islands, and savannas that inspired unforgettable movie worlds.

events.title: Finding Nemo's Great Barrier Reef
events.narrative: Marlin's ocean journey begins in waters inspired by this famous reef system.
events.revealText: The Great Barrier Reef near Queensland inspired the colorful marine world of Finding Nemo.

events.title: The Lion King's Pride Lands
events.narrative: This East African ecosystem inspired the sweeping landscapes of the Pride Lands.
events.revealText: The Serengeti's plains and wildlife informed the visual style of The Lion King.

events.title: Moana's Pacific Voyaging World
events.narrative: Moana's island culture and navigation traditions draw from this South Pacific nation.
events.revealText: Samoa and neighboring Pacific cultures inspired Moana's seafaring story world.

events.title: Lilo & Stitch's Island Home
events.narrative: This Hawaiian city reflects the coastal setting and spirit of ohana.
events.revealText: Oahu's communities and beaches inspired the setting for Lilo & Stitch.

events.title: Up's Paradise Falls Inspiration
events.narrative: The dramatic tabletop mountains and waterfalls in this region inspired Paradise Falls.
events.revealText: Venezuela's tepui landscapes in Canaima National Park influenced the world of Up.

chapters.title: Cities, Castles, and Culture
chapters.intro: Finish with movie-inspired cities and regions rich in architecture, tradition, and history.

events.title: Frozen's Fjord Kingdom
events.narrative: Arendelle's look drew heavily from this Norwegian harbor city and nearby fjords.
events.revealText: Bergen's architecture and Norway's dramatic coastlines inspired Frozen's kingdom.

events.title: Ratatouille's Paris
events.narrative: This French capital serves as the culinary and visual heart of Ratatouille.
events.revealText: Parisian streets, rooftops, and kitchens define the charm of Ratatouille.

events.title: Coco's Day of the Dead Setting
events.narrative: This Mexican region inspired the family traditions and vibrant visual language of Coco.
events.revealText: Oaxaca's Day of the Dead celebrations influenced Coco's color, music, and storytelling.

events.title: Encanto's Mountain Valleys
events.narrative: Encanto's magical setting draws from Colombia's lush valleys and coffee landscapes.
events.revealText: The Cocora Valley and Colombia's Andean regions inspired Encanto's visual world.

events.title: Mulan's Imperial City
events.narrative: Mulan's imperial setting reflects architecture and history centered around this Chinese capital.
events.revealText: Beijing's imperial landmarks helped inspire palace environments in Mulan.
